The validator is specified against verified data schemas (species.json/species.schema.json, learnsets.json, moves.json, PR #366 machine registry, #80 individual record, #106 location field). Engine/lobby integration is an UNVERIFIED TARGET — no battle or link code appears in the audited repo sources; see STAGING.md.

clauseVocabulary._about: Closed vocabulary; a ruleset lists the clauses it enforces.
clauseVocabulary.item-clause: no two party members holding the same item id (#31 held category)
clauseVocabulary.machine-moves: allow | general-only | none — legality of machine-taught moves by PR #366 registry class

mythical-class.dependency: UNENFORCEABLE until #41's proposed presentationClass field lands in the sheet standard — rulesets must not use this clause before then

clauseVocabulary.species-clause: no two party members of one species

rulesetShape.levelValueStatus: OPEN — Mochiichao's level scale/cap is not stated in any citable source; a 'set' ruleset cannot run while this is null and the validator must refuse, not improvise

validatorChecks: party-source: entrant individual records (#80) with #106 location == party only
species-exists: resolves in src/data/core/species.json / src/lib/global_roster.json (audit gap: Dorowani/Gabu hold no core record yet, so are not enterable until it closes)

item-legality: #31 registry record with useContext.held == true; item-clause duplicate check
level-handling: natural reads individual level; set reads levelValue (refuses while null)
ability-slot: #107 proposed abilitySlot must name a slot the species record offers — species abilities fields are 0/47 today, so versus cannot honestly open yet

sides._proposedBy: List 17 #157 (157-MULTI-BATTLE-FORMATS.md) — registered into this fragment's home at the List 17 landing so the ruleset has ONE store; no multi format is instanced.

fragment._about: Multi-battle format fragment (List 17 #157) — a #109 ruleset PLUS a sides block. Singles stays #109's home ground and is not redefined. ZERO multi formats instanced; no partner roster exists. The sides block is proposed into #109's fragment home at landing (#109 disposes). Partner AI is #18's scorer stack under the partner's authored class — game lane only; no scorer, clause, or geometry from this format may choreograph a show fight.
